title: 手卷 — Never Seen Whole
summary: A Chinese handscroll restored to its true condition — unrolled one viewport-length at a time, right to left, and never seen whole.
mechanism: A single horizontal overflow-x scroller far wider than the viewport, opened at its rightmost edge, with a per-visit canvas ink landscape; the browser crop enacts the handscroll's arm's-length viewing and a live meter proves you never see more than one length at once.
references: Wang Ximeng, A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains (千里江山圖), 1113
